original_English: List the tables in section 6.2.1 of spec 38.321 (table lookup).
original_query: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.321'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section {sectionNumber:'6.2.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH s, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (s)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) RETURN t.tableId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption
